ohtani.title: Tarik Skubal strikes out 11 in Dodgers' 4-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Tarik Skubal strikes out 11 batters and Kyle Tucker hits a two-run single in the Dodgers' 4-3 win over the Pirates

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits a walk-off and leadoff homer, and Shota Imanaga strikes out 10 in the Cubs' 7-5 win over the White Sox

suzuki.title: Craig Counsell recaps 5-4 loss to Mariners
suzuki.blurb: Craig Counsell recaps some key moments from Saturday's game, breaks down his pitching staff's performance and more after a walk-off loss

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Dylan Cease takes no-no into 7th in Blue Jays' win
okamoto.blurb: Dylan Cease fans eight batters and takes a no-hitter into the 7th inning, leading the Blue Jays to a 4-3 win over the Yankees

murakami.title: Robert Jr.'s two homers spark offense in Mets' win
murakami.blurb: Luis Robert Jr. crushes two homers, plus Carson Benge and Bo Bichette hit solo home runs to power the Mets to a 10-5 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Carson Benge, Robert Stock lift Mets to a 4-2 victory
matsui.blurb: Carson Benge crushes a two-run home run in the 4th inning and Robert Stock strikes out six to lead the Mets to a 4-2 victory over the Padres
